#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 1000005;
unsigned long long st[MAXN];
int top_idx = 0;

void stack_init() {
 top_idx = 0;
}

void stack_push(unsigned long long x) {
 st[++top_idx] = x;
}

void stack_pop() {
 if (top_idx == 0) {
 cout << "Empty\n";
 } else {
 top_idx--;
 }
}

void stack_query() {
 if (top_idx == 0) {
 cout << "Anguei!\n";
 } else {
 cout << st[top_idx] << "\n";
 }
}

void stack_size() {
 cout << top_idx << "\n";
}

void solve() {
 int n;
 cin >> n;
 stack_init();
 string op;
 unsigned long long x;
 while (n--) {
 cin >> op;
 if (op == "push") {
 cin >> x;
 stack_push(x);
 } else if (op == "pop") {
 stack_pop();
 } else if (op == "query") {
 stack_query();
 } else if (op == "size") {
 stack_size();
 }
 }
}

int main() {
 ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
 cin.tie(nullptr);
 int t;
 if (cin >> t) {
 while (t--) {
 solve();
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

const int MAXN = 105;
int st[MAXN];

void stack_push(int x) {

void stack_pop_until(int x) {

 int val = st[top_idx];
 top_idx--;
 count++;
 if (val == x) {
 break;
 }
 }
 cout << count << "\n";
}

}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <iomanip>
using namespace std;

struct State {
 double v;
 double c;
};

vector<State> history;

void init(double v, double c) {
 history.push_back({v, c});
}

void push_solution(double v, double c) {
 State cur = history.back();
 double total_v = cur.v + v;
 double total_c = (cur.v * cur.c + v * c) / total_v;
 history.push_back({total_v, total_c});
}

void pop_solution() {
 if (history.size() > 1) {
 history.pop_back();
 }
}

void print_current() {
 State cur = history.back();
 cout << (long long)cur.v << " " << fixed << setprecision(5) << cur.c << "\n";
}

int main() {
 ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
 cin.tie(nullptr);

 double v0, c0;
 int n;

 if (cin >> v0 >> c0) {
 init(v0, c0);
 cin >> n;
 while (n--) {
 string op;
 cin >> op;
 if (op == "P") {
 double v, c;
 cin >> v >> c;
 push_solution(v, c);
 } else if (op == "Z") {
 pop_solution();
 }
 print_current();
 }
 }

 return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

long long f[20];

long long solve(int n) {
 if (n == 0 || n == 1) return 1;
 if (f[n] > 0) return f[n];

 long long res = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
 res += solve(i) * solve(n - 1 - i);
 }
 return f[n] = res;
}

int main() {
 int n;
 cin >> n;
 cout << solve(n) << endl;
 return 0;
}

const int MOD = 10000;

int main() {

 long long num;

 if (cin >> num) {
 st.push_back(num % MOD);
 while (cin >> op >> num) {
 if (op == '*') {
 int last = st.back();

int n;
int h[1000005];

int t = 0;
long long ans = 0;

void read() {
 if (!(cin >> n)) return;
 for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
 cin >> h[i];
 }
 h[n + 1] = 0;
}

void work() {
 for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
 while (t > 0 && h[i] < h[s[t]]) {
 int c = s[t];
 t--;
 int l = (t == 0) ? 0 : s[t];
 long long w = i - l - 1;
 long long cur = w * h[c];
 if (cur > ans) {
 ans = cur;
 }
 }
 s[++t] = i;
 }
}

void put() {
 cout << ans << "\n";
}

int main() {

 cin.tie(0);

 read();
 work();
 put();

}

};

 }
